d: Job Category Rooms & Guest Services Operations
Location 396 Ghala, Al Azaiba South, Post Box 1465, Muscat 130, OmanVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

At Aloft, we aren’t your typical hotel—but we aren’t too cool for school either. We’re here to be our guests’ launching and landing pad. Whether they are taking their dog for a walk and coming back for a drink, wrapping up a day of meetings with coworkers, or they’re in town to see family, friends, or their favorite band, we offer a hub for connection to others and the area around them, with modern design and personality to boot. We’re looking for confident self-expressers who aren’t afraid to draw outside the lines. If you are someone who gets excited about the possibilities to connect with others, then Aloft Hotels is the place for you. In joining Aloft Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

d: GBM Bahrain is looking for a dynamic, technically proficient and highly motivated individual to join its Software Solutions Group, with a primary focus on Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

The successful candidate will work closely with the sales team, customers, technology partners and GBM's regional technical teams to identify business opportunities, design innovative solutions and demonstrate how emerging technologies can address customer business challenges.

The role requires a combination of hands-on technical capabilities, business understanding, customer engagement skills and a strong passion for emerging technologies, particularly Generative AI and Agentic AI.
Work closely with the sales team to identify, qualify and develop Data & AI opportunities across enterprise and government customers.
Engage with customers to understand their business objectives, technical environments, challenges and requirements.
Design and propose solutions covering data management, data integration, data governance, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence.
Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, product demonstrations and customer workshops.
Independently develop prototypes, proofs of concept (PoCs) and AI use cases to demonstrate business value.
Assist in designing enterprise AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic AI frameworks.
Translate customer business requirements into technical solution architectures.
Prepare technical proposals, solution documentation, architecture diagrams and responses to RFPs and RFIs.
Collaborate with GBM's regional technical teams, infrastructure teams, OEMs and independent software vendors to develop integrated, end-to-end solutions.
Support the creation of repeatable, industry-specific Data & AI solution offerings.
Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, competitive offerings and industry trends.
Pursue relevant technical certifications and continuously enhance technical competencies.
Ensure effective technical handover to implementation and delivery teams following successful sales engagements.
The candidate should possess foundational knowledge and practical exposure to several of the following areas:
Relational databases, SQL and NoSQL databases.
Data warehouses, data lakes and modern lakehouse architectures.
Data integration, ETL/ELT and data pipelines.
Data governance, data quality and metadata management.
Fundamentals of machine learning and deep learning.
Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
AI agents and Agentic AI frameworks.
Fundamentals of responsible AI, AI governance and model evaluation.
Basic understanding of MLOps and LLMOps.
Strong working knowledge of Python and SQL.
Familiarity with REST APIs and application integration.
Basic understanding of Linux, Docker and Kubernetes.
Understanding of cloud, hybrid cloud and on-premises deployment models.
Exposure to open-source Data & AI technologies and frameworks.
Exposure to technologies from IBM, Microsoft, Red Hat, NVIDIA, major cloud providers or emerging Data & AI software vendors would be an added advantage.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering or a related discipline.
3–4 years of relevant experience in Data & AI, software development, technical consulting, solution engineering or technical pre-sales.
Demonstrable hands-on experience in developing data-driven applications, AI solutions or technical prototypes.
Candidates with a software development or data engineering background who aspire to transition into a customer-facing technical pre-sales role are encouraged to apply.
Relevant Data, AI or cloud certifications would be an advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Arabic and English .
Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business and non-technical audiences.
Intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for technology.
Self-driven, proactive and capable of working independently.
Ability to learn and adopt emerging technologies rapidly.
Commercial awareness and a customer-centric mindset.
The role offers an opportunity to work with leading global technology providers, emerging AI software companies and enterprise customers across multiple industries.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop into a Data & AI Solution Architect, taking increasing ownership of complex customer engagements and contributing to the growth of GBM's Data & AI business.
